rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I approved by AAPA, ACCME, AMA, AOA Council on CME or AAFP (min. 50 h); remaining 50 h may be Category II
rules.alternatives: Current NCCPA certification at renewal counts for the general hours (98 general; 97 at first renewal); medical errors, domestic violence and, for prescribers, specialty/controlled-substance hours must still be shown. Up to 5 h via pro bono service; 5 h ethics/risk management for attending a day of board disciplinary hearings.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 2 h medical errors, 1 h HIV/AIDS (Category I, must include Florida law) and 97 h general CME; NCCPA certification may substitute for the 97 general hours.

topics.who: PAs with prescriptive privileges: 3 of 10 required hours in the supervising physician's specialty; course from a Florida statewide physician association (AMA PRA Cat 1, AAPA Cat 1 or AOA 1-A)

rules.notes: All PA licenses expire Jan 31 of even years. Prescribing PAs need 10 h in the supervising physician's specialty (within the 100). Hours must be reported in CE Broker. Fee $280 active renewal (+$10 prescribing registration).
